sentiment_commentary:
• Optimism dominates today despite a deeply negative score of -47.9, driven by 71 quotes that skew heavily mild-to-moderate with few strong voices — this reflects widespread muted or cautious sentiment rather than confident positivity.
• This is near the bottom of Optimism's 203-day range (-67.4 to 23.3), signalling one of the more pessimistic days on record.
• Frustrations dropped sharply from yesterday's 107.2 to 38.7, though 113 strong-intensity quotes still show plenty of people venting hard.
